description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Free agent Terrell Jennings worked out for the Patriots on Friday.
items.impact: Jennings was one of three running backs to work out for New England.
items.title: Terrell Jennings works out for Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Elijah Arroyo underwent further testing on Friday.
items.impact: Arroyo suffered the injury in Thursday's game against the Broncos. There should be an update on him by next week.
items.title: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) undergoes further testing

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed Ben Bartch on injured reserve with a foot injury.
items.impact: Bartch will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.
items.title: Ben Bartch (foot) placed on IR

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tytus Howard (knee) will play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Howard missed practice earlier in the week due to a knee issue, but it's no longer an issue for him and won't prevent him from playing in Week 6. Cleveland's offensive line will be stronger with him in the lineup against Baltimore.
items.title: Tytus Howard (knee) will play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tylan Wallace (knee) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Wallace will be good to go on Sunday, despite being listed with a knee injury at practice earlier in the week. He is unlikely to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
items.title: Tylan Wallace (knee) available to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colby Parkinson is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Parkinson closed the week with a full practice on Friday.
items.title: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Denzel Boston (foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, despite dealing with a foot injury at practice throughout the week. He has been good through the first five weeks of the season and can safely be started in most league formats at this point.
items.title: Denzel Boston (foot) good to go for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Higbee is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.
items.title: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Andrew Vorhees (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Vorhees is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he's still dealing with a foot issue of some kind. If he's sidelined, the interior of Baltimore's offensive line will be weakened with Cam Jurgens (concussion) also out and Emery Jones Jr. (ankle) questionable for Week 6.
items.title: Andrew Vorhees (foot) questionable for Week 6

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Davis Allen is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Allen remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Davis Allen (foot) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kam Curl is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Curl did not practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.
items.title: Kam Curl (ankle) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Blake Gillikin is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Gillikin was added to the injury report on Friday.
items.title: Blake Gillikin (back) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) will be active for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The veteran lineman will be available to play on Sunday, despite being a non-participant at Thursday's practice due to his groin issue. He should continue to be a solid starter for the Ravens moving forward.
items.title: John Simpson (groin) active for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kitan Crawford is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Crawford will have a chance to be activated from injured reserve on Sunday.
items.title: Kitan Crawford (ankle) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zaven Collins is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Collins was added to the injury report for Friday. His status is uncertain for Sunday.
items.title: Zaven Collins (hip) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Budda Baker is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Baker did not practice on Wednesday or Friday this week. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.
items.title: Budda Baker (rest/groin) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Andrew Wingard has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Wingard remained sidelined from practice all week.
items.title: Andrew Wingard (knee) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Wydett Williams Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Williams will be sidelined in concussion protocol.
items.title: Wydett Williams Jr. (concussion) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ja'Marcus Ingram is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Ingram will be a game-time decision on Sunday.
items.title: Ja'Marcus Ingram listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Henry To'oTo'o is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: To'oTo'o had his practice window opened this week. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.
items.title: Henry To'oTo'o (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The rookie will have a chance to make his return to the field after missing several games while on injured reserve. The team will make a determination about his availability closer to game time, and fantasy managers should temper expectations for him this week, especially with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined against Cleveland.
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) officially questionable for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Romello Height did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Height remains uncertain for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.title: Romello Height (hand) not practicing Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: James Thompson Jr. was at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Thompson is on track to return from his ankle injury.
items.title: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) practices Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nick Bosa remained absent from practice on Friday.
items.impact: Bosa will need to practice in some capacity on Saturday to have a chance to return for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) not practicing Friday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Roger Rosengarten (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Baltimore will have their starting right tackle on Sunday, as Rosengarten has been cleared to play, despite still dealing with a knee issue. Their offensive line will be at close to full health this week, except for Cam Jurgens (concussion) being sidelined.
items.title: Roger Rosengarten (knee) cleared to play Sunday

title: Fantasy Player News
